scope: Performance-only fixed-attempt pilots on unchanged spectral-proposal targets; no cosmological summary, convergence certification or scientific gate change. Live runs remain untouched.
models: CPL linear pilot; linear and smooth01 actual dependency/cache checks; smooth03 has identical dependency graph but is not separately timed.
factor_zero: One block including all parameters. Other factors mean eight cosmology coordinates in the slow block and five CMB nuisances plus epsilon (when sampled) in the fast block.
proposal: Installed Cobaya BlockedProposer, unchanged correlated author covariance, fixed scale1.6, no adaptive learning/dragging/output thinning. Epsilon added with declared .02 proposal SD and zero covariance; performance could improve with learned correlations.
cap_policy: Abort entire benchmark if cap exceeded; never turn a capped evaluation into a rejected point or alter support.
diagnostics: Preserve every attempted state including rejection repeats; discard initial25percent only for performance ESS. Short real-target ESS is descriptive and unstable, not qualification. Known Gaussian ESS/CPU uses both actual cheap-control cost and an explicitly modeled reference slow/fast cost, not a measured cosmology speedup.
cache_validation: For every parameter, compare cached and uncached full likelihood/prior vectors. Fast-only moves must add zero cosmology theory calls. Exact native fallback uses unchanged target when within the cap.
